assignments.package_label: עָלְמָא דְּאִתְכַּסְיָא — לֵאָה, הַלֵּב, וְרִקּוּדֵי הַחֲתֻנָּה
assignments.reason: שמחת הלב (joy of the heart) shares the essential nature of Package 1's Binah/heart domain. The text states 'וְהֵם נִתְנַשְּׂאִים עַל-יְדֵי הַלֵּב, הַיְנוּ עַל-יְדֵי שִׂמְחַת הַלֵּב' — the feet are uplifted through the heart, i.e., through joy of the heart. The heart (לב) is already in Package 1 and is equated with Binah/עלמא דאתכסיא. שמחת הלב is the active expression of that same concealed Binah-light — the joy that animates the heart and drives the wedding dance. It is a face of the hidden world becoming manifest, sharing Package 1's essential nature of Binah-revelation.
